profile.name: Sanskruti Gorle
profile.bioShort: Passionate Computer Science undergraduate at SIT Nagpur engineering agentic AI systems, predictive data mining models, and aesthetic interactive web platforms. Driven by algorithmic problem-solving and modern software architecture.

featuredProjects.title: AETHER — Luxury Landing Page
featuredProjects.subtitle: Dark editorial luxury product showcase featuring interactive sneaker reveals, kinetic typography, and fluid micro-interactions.
featuredProjects.overview: AETHER is a high-concept dark editorial luxury e-commerce showcase built to push boundaries in creative frontend development. Inspired by high-fashion street aesthetics, it incorporates custom serif typography, dynamic lookbook displays, interactive product colorway switchers, and subtle scroll-triggered layout transitions.
highlights: Interactive editorial layout with luxury aesthetic and smooth reveal animations.
Custom lookbook grid with responsive hover states and modal previews.
Zero-dependency pure vanilla CSS & JavaScript delivering high-speed 60fps interaction.

featuredProjects.title: ATLAS Studio — Architecture Platform
featuredProjects.subtitle: Minimal, image-led multi-page platform for architecture and interior design studios with fluid client navigation.
featuredProjects.overview: ATLAS Studio is an expansive multi-page architectural studio web application. Built for luxury interior designers and architectural practices, it features dedicated project portfolios, services breakdown, interactive inquiry forms, and an editorial gallery showcasing space planning and architectural structures.
highlights: Multi-page architecture encompassing Home, Projects, Philosophy, and Contact endpoints.
Minimalist aesthetic with high-contrast architectural imagery and clean whitespace.
Mobile-first responsive fluid grids optimized across all screen formats.

featuredProjects.title: GoalMate — Agentic AI Goal Tracker
featuredProjects.subtitle: Autonomous multi-agent system that breaks down ambitious personal goals into actionable milestones, habits, and streak schedules.
featuredProjects.overview: GoalMate is an intelligent Agentic AI framework designed to solve self-regulation and goal abandonment. Powered by autonomous agentic task breakdown workflows, the system takes high-level user ambitions, analyzes schedule constraints, and proactively generates adaptive sub-tasks, habit tracking, and progress coaching.
highlights: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration for hierarchical goal deconstruction.
Interactive dashboard featuring streak mechanics, habit calendars, and dynamic charts.
Full-stack architecture integrating responsive frontend with Python backend agents.

featuredProjects.title: CrediMine — Bank Loan Risk Mining Platform
featuredProjects.subtitle: Predictive data mining engine assessing credit risk, debt-to-income ratios, and loan approval probabilities using ML pipelines.
featuredProjects.overview: A comprehensive data mining and financial technology platform that evaluates loan applicants in real time. The system executes end-to-end KDD (Knowledge Discovery in Databases) pipelines — from raw transaction ingestion and feature correlation heatmaps to supervised classification models for default rate prediction.
highlights: End-to-end machine learning classification pipelines with cross-validated ROC-AUC metrics.
Interactive financial analytics dashboard displaying loan distributions and default rates.
Real-time applicant risk calculator with attribute relevance feedback.
